morbi.headline: Mixed margin signals emerge for Morbi ceramic units amid fluctuating gas and propane prices.
what_changed: Morbi ceramic industry secured a Rs 5 discount on natural gas prices.
Propane gas prices surged by Rs 7,300 per metric tonne, creating an input-cost shock.
Large suspicious stock of imported coal was discovered in a closed local unit.
stress_signals: Propane price hike of Rs 7,300/tonne threatens immediate margin pressure for vitrified and wall tile manufacturing kilns [2f37d34283cf]
Suspicious stock of imported coal found in a closed factory in Rafaleshwar GIDC raises operational/compliance concerns [f675c060fa53]
improvement_signals: Natural gas prices dropped from Rs 82 following a Rs 5 discount for the Morbi ceramic industry [279312659941]
Kajaria Ceramics beat Q2 2026 sales and profit revenue estimates [c28b87e03125]
what_to_watch: Effective dates, full pricing structures, and supplier specifics for the natural gas price discount.
Margin impact on propane-dependent vitrified and wall tile manufacturers.
Further legal or operational details regarding the coal stock seized at Rafaleshwar GIDC.

surat.headline: Surat faces cost shocks, export demand divergence, and mixed liquidity ahead of Diwali.
what_changed: Textile mills hit by power cuts and electricity tariff hikes alongside pre-Diwali artisan shortages and weak demand.
Diamond cluster shows conflicting signals: pre-Diwali demand uptick versus ongoing export slump and worker bonus disputes.
Surat Diamond Bourse operational traction remains strained three years post-launch amid regional rough diamond supply shortages.
stress_signals: Textile mill margins pressured by power outages, electricity cost increases, labor shortages, and demand deficits [385f9b90ae46, 0bc3ac5bf041].
US demand slump triggering factory shutdowns in apparel and diamond export segments [caa34a6cf84e].
Pre-Diwali liquidity strain evidenced by diamond worker union demands for unpaid overtime and bonuses [c8a89bd2019b].
Trade credit risks highlighted by a broker-driven delivery fraud of Rs 1.69 crore against a local textile mill [25d6a0f6dbec].
improvement_signals: Trade associations recovered Rs 6 crore in stuck mercantile dues for 70 textile traders across major Surat markets [a523a4bf860d].
Surat diamond units reported a festive resurgence supported by pre-Diwali and global demand [01cb30b63e0d].
Technical textiles segment gaining traction via defence fabric expansion, Mercedes-Benz research talks, and hotfix waste repurposing [c4aec155608f, 3a4ce1852d7c, da1ef316cd6d].
what_to_watch: Working capital utilization and power bill overdues among MMF weaving and processing units following electricity rate increases.
Pre-Diwali bonus payout completion and payroll account churn across SME diamond cutting and polishing units.
Receivable aging and debtor concentration for fabric suppliers transacting through unverified broker networks.
